name: fitweb-gate-v5-1
prompt: Edit this image and keep the camera, framing, scale model style, colours and soft light exactly the same. Keep these exactly as they are: the gate canopy, the left guard block with its glass cabin, the FIT logo and copper plaque, the right pillar with the Forteasia logo, the canopy lettering FORTEASIA INDUSTRIAL TOWNSHIP, the single red-and-white boom barrier at the guard cabin (exactly one barrier, add no other barrier or pole), the flags, grass, workers, the container truck, tipper truck, pickup and forklift at the gate, the working factory on the LEFT, and the large logistics warehouse with loading docks on the RIGHT. Make these changes: 1) REMOVE the small navy warehouse shed in the middle (the one right behind the canopy, between the factory and the big warehouse) completely, so there are only two buildings: one factory on the left and one warehouse on the right. 2) The township road that goes in through the gate, with its two carriageways, green median and young trees, must continue STRAIGHT and unbroken through the township into the far distance, between the factory on the left and the warehouse on the right, all the way to the top of the model where it fades softly into the beige background. The factory yard and the warehouse yard each connect to this road with a short side road. 3) Make the main road in the foreground, outside the gate, much WIDER: six lanes, three each way, with a raised central divider with a thin strip of grass and small shrubs, white dashed lane markings, kerbs and a footpath on the gate side. Keep the T-junction with the gate road and the turn arrows, and keep the cars on it in their lanes. Both ends still fade softly into the beige background, never a hard cut. No new text or logos, no watermark.
